title: What Should You Record After a Workplace Near Miss?
seoTitle: Workplace Near-Miss Report: What to Record | Fit2Trade
description: A practical Ireland and UK guide to recording, investigating and closing out workplace near misses without confusing internal learning with regulator reporting.
excerpt: A useful near-miss record captures what nearly happened, the potential consequence, the controls that failed and the action needed to stop it happening again.
author: Fit2Trade
relatedKeywords: what to record in a near miss report
